outskirts/vey.first: Nearly... there. Sorry, I’d stand, but I’d regret it. Vey. The fire’s for anyone.
outskirts/vey.back: Back again. Sit, if you like. I won’t ask where you’ve been.
outskirts/vey.rowan: Rowan’s coming over tonight. Says he’s bringing his own bowl. I’ll pretend that’s a surprise.
outskirts/olan.first: Twenty to four. Every blessed day. ...You came from the west? There’s nothing west but the old camp. Patrols turn at the post. Mind them.
outskirts/olan.back: You got past the patrols? Hm. Most turn round at the first post.
outskirts/olan.muster: Soldiers at every post, and I never heard them march in. Did you?
outskirts/olan.slow: Then go slow at the crossing.
outskirts/olan.hint: Mara’s after the Glass post? Upper road. Quicker, if heights don’t bother you.
outskirts/mara.ask: Stay flat, you... Oh. Hello. Mara, surveyor. Could I borrow your legs? Three posts between here and the Muster, and I need a bearing off each one. Stand close until the vane swings.
outskirts/mara.progress: Still missing some. Ash is by the old camp. Glass is up on the high ledge in Watcher’s Cut. Iron’s at the Muster.
outskirts/mara.done: That’s all three. It reaches the woods. Thank you. Keep the chart; I’ll draw another.
outskirts/mara.handover: Keep it out of the rain. I’ve only got the one.
outskirts/mara.replay: Everything you’ve walked is drawn in. The blanks are the bits you haven’t.
outskirts/rowan.opening: Gate’s shut. Nothing gets through. ...Except you. How?
outskirts/rowan.accept: Hm. Then walk up that tower and bring the bell down. Cart onto the iron stop first, then pull the brake. Bell comes to the empty post by my bench.
outskirts/rowan.past: Everyone moved to the camp. I didn’t. Last time I left a post, people died while I was gone. You ever leave one you shouldn’t have?
outskirts/rowan.name: Rowan, by the way. I’m still deciding what to make of you.
outskirts/rowan.long:
My brother and I took the evening watch together. He’d moan about the cold, then hand me half his blanket. After he died I kept doing both shifts. Nobody asked me to. Evening came and I didn’t know what else to do with it.

This is better. I can hear the bell from the bench, and I can see the road.
outskirts/rowan.reward: A drake roosted over that bell. Followed it all the way down. It’ll carry you, if you let it.
outskirts/traveler.greet: Oh, hello. Road ahead goes through, I think. Mind if I walk behind you?
outskirts/rowan.task.ballast: Counterweight first. Roll the stone cart onto the iron stop east of here and pull the brake.
outskirts/rowan.task.bell: Up the tower ledges. Let the bell go from the top; the pulley brings it down.
outskirts/rowan.task.hang: Now bring it back to the empty post by my bench.
narration/prologue: His vision swims. The Knight rises beneath a sky he does not remember.
woods/orra.first: Stopped. Again. Oh, hello. Orra. I’d tell you the time if I had it. If you’re going deeper, look at a branch before you trust it. Some of them aren’t there.
woods/orra.revisit: Still stopped. I’ve been told never to shake it, so I’ve stopped shaking it. The path back’s clear.
woods/orra.muster: Bells started while you were off. Nobody I know is ringing them. If the low road’s crowded, there’s the workers’ reserve above the far end of Briar Run. My daughter used to fetch wraps from it. Let it go and a walkway drops through the canopy.
woods/pell.first: You’re not resin crew. Here’s the trick, then. Amber on the windward side of a branch, it’s real. Amber on the lee side, don’t jump. You’ll go straight through.
woods/pell.revisit: Worked it out, did you? Took me a nettle patch.
woods/hale.before: Another one for the sword? Roots have it. Vine runs to a counterweight. Hang off that, not the hilt.
woods/hale.after: Where’d you learn to hold it like that? I’ll sit a while. Shoulder’s not finished complaining.
woods/bram.first: Easy, easy. Oh! Bram. Sorry. Crossing? Stay where my lamp reaches. Any branch the light shines through isn’t real.
woods/bram.repeat: There, see how it goes straight through that one? Not that one. I’ll wait while you find another.
woods/bram.done: Across! I’ll leave her burning on this side, so you can find your way back.
causeway/oren.first: Hear that? Gate chain, carrying the whole load on its own. Oren. Chainwright. If you’re headed through the Drop Yard, you could save it.
causeway/oren.revisit: Still pulling. I can feel it through the handle.
causeway/oren.muster: Every link rattled last night, end to end. Nobody touched the handle.
causeway/sable.first: Two ways over. You’re not one of the yard’s. Lower planks: slow, but covered. Hanging walk: quick, and every guard can see you. Pick the one you can manage today.
causeway/sable.revisit: Another crossing? Breathe first, whichever way.
woods/refuge.opening: Mind the step, the end’s rotten. Elsie. You look like you’ve walked a long way. The moths took my lantern. They come for the light every evening, and tonight they took the whole thing, off east through the trees. Could you follow them? They never go far at a time.
woods/refuge.accept: Go gently when you catch them. And mind yourself on the way home; take a knock and they’ll have it off you again.
woods/refuge.firstReturn: Lost a bit of pantry yesterday. I finished cooking from the doorway. The house isn’t what it was. The lantern first; then the step.
woods/refuge.ready: Is it too salty? I never remember if I’ve salted it.
woods/refuge.longEnding:
My sister cut the carrots so small you could barely find them. Said it made the soup go further. I cut mine big. If someone’s walked all day, there ought to be something on the spoon.

I know this place needs more than a board and a lamp. But I can mend a little and cook a little while I work out what’s next. There’s another helping if you want it.
woods/refuge.ending: Two bowls and a working lamp. That’s supper. Sit before it gets cold.
woods/refuge.rewardLine: The moths love that lantern now. Hold it up high and they’ll carry you over the trees.
woods/refuge.task.line: The line’s tied off at the fork, by the wooden peg. Up the branches east of here.
woods/refuge.task.lantern: Bring her home steady. If you take a knock, the moths will have her back.
woods/refuge.task.floor: There’s a spare board by the door. Lay it over that step for me.
woods/refuge.task.table: Now hang her over the table, by the stove.
causeway/defector.opening: Thirty-nine, forty. Good evening. I’m Silas. Forgive me for not stopping; I can’t. The governor above the maintenance lift turns me every forty paces. Ride the lift up and stop it. It has one soft tooth, the bright one. Strike that.
causeway/defector.accept: It comes round every few seconds. Strike anything else and you’ll only bruise your arm. I’ll be here. I’m always here.
causeway/defector.firstReturn: I can count the turns. I can decide to stop. My legs listen to neither. There’s a patch of sunlight past the end of my route. I’d like to stand in it.
causeway/defector.ready: Forty-one. Forty-two. I’ve lost count. Good.
causeway/defector.longEnding: I can go anywhere. I find I can’t think of anywhere. May I walk with you until I do? The sunlight first.
causeway/defector.rewardLine: It counts its own links now. Hold on, and it will take you.
causeway/defector.task.brake: The brake handle is beside the lift, next to my walk.
causeway/defector.task.gear: Ride the lift up. Strike the bright tooth as it comes round.
causeway/defector.task.gate: The gate, if you would. It swings outward.
updrafts/cartographer.opening: Someone on the stairs. Heavier than the wind. You walk like you’re carrying iron. I need one reading from the upper channel. Could you divert the current into the funnel above my desk?
updrafts/cartographer.accept: Funnel above the desk. Mind the chimes on the way. They’re older than I am.
updrafts/cartographer.firstReturn: I meant to leave in spring. Not this spring; an earlier one. There’s always another sheet to check. The coast first, when I go. I can describe every inch of it. I’ve never been.
updrafts/cartographer.ready: That interval shouldn’t occur. Don’t touch it. Leave it.
updrafts/cartographer.longEnding: I could take another reading. I won’t. Help me move the desk outside, would you? The instruments can come. I’d like to listen to that for a while.
updrafts/cartographer.ending: Help me move the desk outside? I’d like to listen.
updrafts/cartographer.after: The coast first. I’m taking the small notebook.
updrafts/cartographer.rewardLine: Frame’s mended. On this wind, she’ll carry you the length of the canyon.
updrafts/cartographer.task.funnel: Carry the channel’s current to the funnel. Your portal can bridge the gap.
updrafts/cartographer.task.chimes: Now send it through the chimes. I want to hear what it does.
marksman/recruit.opening: Nope. Oh. Hi. Sorry. I’m, I can make the crossing. I can. My helmet’s up in the watchtower, is the thing. Could you get it? I’d go, but.
marksman/recruit.accept: The one with the flag. Right. Then we cross together. Stay close? Not that I need. Just close.
marksman/recruit.firstReturn: It was my uncle’s. Three campaigns. I know it won’t make me less scared. I’d still like it back.
marksman/recruit.ready: Your leg, is it all right? I pulled hard when that brace came down. Sorry. Not sorry. You know.
marksman/recruit.longEnding: I thought I’d feel different with it on. I’m still scared, mostly. But we got across. Could we go back for it later?
marksman/recruit.rewardLine: I re-strung both ballistas. A bolt will carry you. I’ve done the sums. Mostly.
marksman/recruit.task.helmet: It’s at the top of the ruined watchtower. The one with the flag.
marksman/recruit.task.crossing: Shelter to shelter. Tell me before you move, all right?
keep/archivist.opening: Forty, forty-one, gap. Three accounts of the night the gate fell, and not one of them on these shelves. One is bricked up in the old reading room. One is on the outer wall, where the steward wrote it. The third is in the belfry, and the wind has had it for years. Will you bring them?
keep/archivist.accept: The reading room is west of here, high up past the first stair. They bricked it up after the fire; you’ll have to break in. The wall needs climbing. And the belfry pages blow off the ledges. Lift one and the rest start going.
keep/archivist.firstReturn: They disagree about the gate, whether it was open. If it was, someone could have stopped what happened. I was on the stairs, helping someone down. Smoke. A sleeve tearing in my hand.
keep/archivist.readyLines.1: The bell-ringer saw the counterweight. Cut. From the inside.
keep/archivist.readyLines.2: Nobody held that gate open, and nobody could have shut it. I’ve been asking the wrong question for nine years. Help me carry these out to the courtyard. I need air.
keep/archivist.longEnding: Nine years. I’ll read them once more, outside. Then I think I’ll stop.
keep/archivist.after: I’m still deciding where to go.
keep/archivist.rewardLine: The ringers’ plan. They could cross the whole wall on the ropes. You’ll manage.
keep/archivist.task.volume-one: The first is up the archive shelves. You’ll have to climb.
keep/archivist.task.volume-two: The second fell into the upper gallery.
keep/archivist.task.volume-three: The last is on the highest shelf, over the courtyard.
gaol/keeper.opening: Work order? No work order. I’m the Service Keeper; this entrance needs one.
gaol/keeper.accept: Straight there and back. There’s a brown-paper parcel on the shelf. That’s mine.
gaol/keeper.firstReturn: Office upstairs sends the orders. The office has been empty all week. I stamp what comes. Nothing comes.
gaol/keeper.ready: That’s the one. Someone moved it, before you ask.
gaol/keeper.longEnding: Service personnel are permitted to eat. Nobody specified which side of the door. Leave it on the latch when you go.
gaol/keeper.ending: Leave the door on the latch.
gaol/keeper.after: On the latch. Don’t make me regret it.
gaol/keeper.rewardLine: Jailers’ cage. Runs on the overhead rail. I didn’t see you take it.
gaol/keeper.task.door: Door’s open. Go on, before I change my mind.
gaol/keeper.task.lunch: Brown paper, on the shelf in the alcove. Don’t squash it.
frostfell/winter.opening: Don’t mind me. Ines. The coal’s in the upper shelter. The sack’s split, so use the bucket. I can’t manage the steps anymore.
frostfell/winter.accept: Mind the last step. It’s dreadful.
frostfell/winter.firstReturn: Heating this room will melt everything in it. I know. I’ve been cold a long time. Could you set the blue cup outside first? The handle’s glued; hold it from underneath.
frostfell/winter.ready: Sit. That was my husband’s chair. He’d have told you to sit as well.
frostfell/winter.longEnding: He swore it was the comfortable chair. It’s a dreadful chair. Sit anyway; I’ll find a cushion. Put a bowl under those flowers, would you? They’re about to drip.
frostfell/winter.ending: He swore it was the comfortable one. It’s a dreadful chair.
frostfell/winter.after: The floor’s still wet. Mind your feet.
frostfell/winter.rewardLine: My sled from the perfect day. The dogs know every road up here.
frostfell/winter.task.coal: Up to the shelter. The bucket’s by the split sack.
frostfell/winter.task.stove: Into the stove with it. The matches are on the shelf.
court/ember-pet.opening: Don’t touch his back. You smell of frost. Where’ve you been? Never mind. He’s too hot to settle. Could you bring a little cold through?
court/ember-pet.accept: Start small. I need to see how he takes it.
court/ember-pet.firstReturn: Water, shade, moving his bed. Won’t drink. Been pacing since yesterday. Everyone up the road wants out of the cold, and he’s on fire.
court/ember-pet.ready: Look at his feet. He only does that asleep.
court/ember-pet.longEnding: I’m still waiting for something to go wrong. Oh, there he is, snapping at your glove. He’s always been a little bastard. Thank you.
court/ember-pet.ending: There he is, snapping at your glove.
court/ember-pet.rewardLine: Your bit of winter grew into a fox. It’ll make you a road.
court/ember-pet.task.frost: Carry some cold from the channel. Your portals can do it.
court/ember-pet.task.settle: Now leave him a cool corner and let him choose. Stand back a bit.
emberdeep/quota.opening.3: You’re not the supervisor, are you?
emberdeep/quota.accept.4: Shame. Follow the belt and look at the counters, then. Someone should.
emberdeep/quota.firstReturn.6: That belt feeds scrap. I’m scrap. Supervisor said keep the line moving.
emberdeep/quota.firstReturn.7: The supervisor’s office has been empty for months.
emberdeep/quota.longEnding.12: Right. Sit down, then. I’ve lunch for two.
emberdeep/quota.rewardLine: One cart, off the books. Don’t tell the counters.
emberdeep/quota.task.counter: Both counters, at the end of the belt. Read them for us.
emberdeep/quota.task.loop: Swing the return chute into the loop. Then neither of us has to do a thing.
foundry/automaton.opening: Ah. Good evening. Please hold the left panel. The right is already damaged. I am building a birdhouse.
foundry/automaton.accept: There was a gripping attachment in the cooling forge. I cannot reach it.
foundry/automaton.firstReturn: This is the fifth. I cannot feel the point where the wood begins to split. They nest in the broken machinery. Their last nest fell.
foundry/automaton.longEnding: Is the roof straight? Please check again. I would prefer not to make a sixth. A bird is approaching. We should be still.
foundry/automaton.ending: A bird is approaching. We should be still.
foundry/automaton.after: It is inspecting the roof. I am waiting.
foundry/automaton.rewardLine: I have found small work that I like. Please stand in my hands.
foundry/automaton.task.mould: The attachment is sealed in the old cooling mould. Strike it from above.
foundry/automaton.task.roof: Please return the attachment and hold the left panel. Gently.
inversion/neighbors.opening.2: And I’ve explained about the floor.
inversion/neighbors.opening.3: Oh, a visitor. Do excuse us. Wendell. And that’s Ottilie, upside down.
inversion/neighbors.opening.4: He’s the one upside down. Could you join our tables? Then neither of us has to move.
inversion/neighbors.accept: That one, and mine. Mind the cups.
inversion/neighbors.firstReturn.5: We used to meet on the middle landing.
inversion/neighbors.firstReturn.6: It collapsed. Last time I went over, he wore the tea.
inversion/neighbors.longEnding.10: I did, dear. You used to try catching my spoons. Pass the biscuits.
inversion/neighbors.after: He still tries to catch them.
inversion/neighbors.rewardLine: Up here it’s one long corridor. Wipe your feet.
inversion/neighbors.task.service: Our tea service went over to the courtyard shelf. You’ll have to turn the world to reach it.
inversion/neighbors.task.tables: Now link my table to his. Your portals, dear.
citadel/figure.opening: Can you hear me? Through the glass?
citadel/figure.accept: The release is on your side. I can see it. I can’t reach it.
citadel/figure.firstReturn: How long have I been in here? Nothing on this side changes, so nothing marks the time. There are lights behind you. I’ve never seen them up close.
citadel/figure.ready: It’s warm on this side too. I thought it’d be cold.
citadel/figure.longEnding: Could we stop by the lights first? You can go on ahead if you need to. I want to see that part.
citadel/figure.ending: Could we stop by the lights first?
citadel/figure.after: The lights are better up close.
citadel/figure.rewardLine: Step into one shard, out of the next. The glass remembers you now.
citadel/figure.task.release: Hold the second contact with your echo while you work the release. I’ll push from this side.
throne/alarm.opening: Hands off the striker. Break it and the backup starts. You’re no soldier of ours. Can you climb? We need the all-clear rung from the upper tower.
throne/alarm.accept: Three short, two long. Don’t rush the last two.
throne/alarm.firstReturn: Silence means the tower’s fallen. It was built to keep ringing after everyone here was dead. Half these soldiers know the fight’s over. The alarm keeps calling them back.
throne/alarm.ready: That’s it. They’re leaving their posts.
throne/alarm.longEnding: You can hear yourself think. Look, that one’s asleep already. Tomorrow can wait.
throne/alarm.rewardLine: Ring it, and every door on the throne road opens for one breath. Run.
throne/alarm.task.signal: Up the signal tower. Three short, then two long. Give the last two room.
deepline/miner.opening: Someone up there? The cage is stuck!
deepline/miner.accept: Take the siding! The main line goes straight past. I hear every cart.
deepline/miner.firstReturn.1: Is the board still up by the hoist? Is my name on it?
deepline/miner.ready: Look at that. Crossed me clean out.
deepline/miner.longEnding: Pass me the pencil. That’s me back in. This other name, has anyone actually checked that shaft?
deepline/miner.after: Name’s back. Waiting for my legs to stop shaking.
deepline/miner.task.hoist: Load a cart on the siding and run it at the hoist. That’ll drive the cage up.
deepline/miner.task.ledger: Walk me to the station ledger. Slowly. My legs aren’t mine yet.
cliffs/sailors.opening: Lost a brass charm up in the rigging. Begging pardon. Hallam, bosun. If you’re going aloft, keep an eye out.
cliffs/sailors.accept: Brass, size of a thumb, split down the middle. Mind the loose line above the crossbeam.
cliffs/sailors.firstReturn: My father’s. Carried it every voyage. I’m not saying it holds the ship together. I’d just like it back.
cliffs/sailors.ready.1: He’s got hold of it. Let him keep it till we get him down.
cliffs/sailors.longEnding.5: So far. Both hands on the rope now; there’s still the night to get through.
cliffs/sailors.ending: Both hands on the rope now.
cliffs/sailors.after: Half a charm each. Seems to work.
cliffs/sailors.rewardLine: For luck. She runs before any wind on these cliffs.
cliffs/sailors.task.charm: There’s a lad stuck up on the top line with it. Your hook will reach him.
cliffs/sailors.task.share: Bring him down to the deck. We’ll sort the charm between us.
shores/birthday.opening: Is he looking? Oh, you’re not him. Hello! Candles. We need the tin from the wreck. Put it behind the sail when you have it.
shores/birthday.accept: Cobb. It’s his birthday. Six of us and one cake. Keep the candles dry; there’s only the one tin.
shores/birthday.firstReturn.1: Why is he hiding behind the boat? Did someone warn him?
shores/birthday.ready.4: You said there were six of them.
shores/birthday.ready.5: There are. We made a cake.
shores/birthday.longEnding.6: Porch would suit me. Don’t make an announcement about it.
shores/birthday.ending: Porch would suit me. Don’t make an announcement.
shores/birthday.after: He’s on the porch. Third slice.
shores/birthday.rewardLine: Saved the biggest one. Light it and hold on.
shores/birthday.task.candles: The tin’s in the upper cabin of the wreck. Keep it dry!
shores/birthday.task.invite: Cobb’s behind the boat. Tell him about the party, and let him pick where he sits.
colony/mother.opening: Not you as well. Everyone’s told me to stop being difficult. No. You’re new here. My sealed cup is in the old shelter. Would you bring that one? I want to know where it’s been.
colony/mother.accept: The old one, past the pipe. Thank you. Everyone else has argued with me by now.
colony/mother.firstReturn: They told me to drink and stop being difficult. That isn’t the same as explaining what Sable did to the water. I’ll ask him myself, after the little one’s asleep.
colony/mother.ready: I spoke to him. He actually answered.
colony/mother.longEnding: The neighbour used to defend the pipe as well. She admitted it. That helped. Mine first, only a little. Thank you for bringing our own cup.
colony/mother.ending: Mine first. Only a little, to start.
colony/mother.after: The cup lives by her bed now.
colony/mother.rewardLine: He folded this for you. Don’t laugh; it flies.
colony/mother.task.cup: Our cup’s in the old shelter, sealed. Past the pipe.
colony/mother.task.water: Ask Sable to come by the spring. Just him. After the little one’s asleep.
path/pilgrim.opening: Oof. Good afternoon! I’m travelling with rather less these days. Would you carry this up the last climb? Please don’t open it.
path/pilgrim.firstReturn: Yes, it clinks. Medals. Among other things. I know what the one for exemplary humility says.
path/pilgrim.ready: I should have carried it myself. At least let me make lunch.
path/pilgrim.longEnding: That one was for exceptional restraint. Holds the pot steady, doesn’t it? Sit. I can manage lunch without asking you to carry anything else.
path/pilgrim.ending: That one was for exceptional restraint. Holds the pot steady, doesn’t it?
path/pilgrim.after: One medal under the pot. The rest are still in the sack.
path/pilgrim.rewardLine: My lightest cloak. Jump from the shrine wall; the road will pass under you.
path/pilgrim.task.sack: Up the side climb to the summit bench. Do mind the clinking.
palace/garden.opening: His Majesty wants these open. The flowers need the dark. Who let you into the garden? Doesn’t matter. Three shutters, through the mirror gallery. Mind the light off the upper one.
palace/garden.firstReturn: I’ve told him what the light does. He says find another way. They’re flowers. He wants it kept the way she loved it. She never saw it like this.
palace/garden.ready: We didn’t lose that one. Look, by the bench.
palace/garden.longEnding: Will I be in trouble? Probably. I’m tired of watching it die. Sit a moment. That one by the bench hasn’t opened in years.
palace/garden.ending: Will I be in trouble? Probably.
palace/garden.rewardLine: Gone to seed. The pod lifts at dusk. Point it, and it drifts.
palace/garden.task.shutter-one: The lower shutter, beside the mirror gallery.
palace/garden.task.shutter-two: The middle one. Climb the shaded gallery.
palace/garden.task.shutter-three: The last one’s above the garden. Mind the light.
outskirts/quest.road-without-a-name.acti: Two records left to compare. The Sky-Well plaque in the Updrafts. The foundation inscription at the Ruined Keep. Copy them down when you’re passing—no special trip.
outskirts/quest.road-without-a-name.turn: They match. Same spacing on the plaque as on the Keep’s footings: same builders, same road. That goes on the chart as fact now, not a guess. Thank you.
outskirts/quest.road-without-a-name.comp: Your notes are on the chart. Next person who takes a wagon out that way gets more than we had.
updrafts/quest.kindling-the-sky.active: Frostfell folk can bank a fire to keep for days. Help Nim carry one through Frostfell, then come and look at the Choir flue. I want to know if heat rides this wind.
updrafts/quest.kindling-the-sky.turnIn: The flue sang. Should’ve roared. Don’t ask me why.
updrafts/quest.kindling-the-sky.complete: Every time the wind shifts, I hear that note.
emberdeep/quest.couriers-proof.active: Two things. Send one of their shots back through your portals. Then read the prayer in the Inversion. Tell me after.
emberdeep/quest.couriers-proof.turnIn: So the seal never cared what you are. Only what it takes you for. I can use that.
emberdeep/quest.couriers-proof.complete: Every locked door I see now, I think: beaten one of you.
woods/quest.inventory-of-effects.active: This list says these things are yours. I’ve never seen you before, which is odd. Three entries are missing: the broken standard past the Woods, the Frost Court’s siphon record, and the Foundry ledger. If you pass them, would you look?
woods/quest.inventory-of-effects.turnIn: That completes it. I hoped the list would feel less familiar once it was finished. It doesn’t. Forgive me, that isn’t your concern.
woods/quest.inventory-of-effects.complet: All entered, and in order. I’m sorry they were ever scattered.
causeway/quest.release-the-causeway.offe: Two safety catches in the Drop Yard. Knock the first loose, let the hoist settle on its cradle, then free the upper one.
causeway/quest.release-the-causeway.acti: The cradle’s meant to take that weight. Right now the gate’s taking it. First catch, then the upper.
causeway/quest.release-the-causeway.turn: Listen. Nothing. That’s a chain that isn’t about to snap.
causeway/quest.release-the-causeway.comp: I’ll keep this road open. You’ll want somewhere to come back to.
marksman/quest.the-open-watch.offer: The watch token above the gallery’s got my mark on it. I charted this road before anyone put a watch on it. I’d like it back.
marksman/quest.the-open-watch.active: I’ll be at the far gate, out of the line of fire.
marksman/quest.the-open-watch.turnIn: That’s my mark. Cut it before any of them wore masks. Here, the purse is yours.
marksman/quest.the-open-watch.complete: I used to know every archer on this watch by name. Couldn’t tell you one now.
woods/workshop.ethereal-goods.offer: I set this fragment aside when I sorted the last delivery. I’d rather it went with someone than sat in my drawer.
woods/workshop.ethereal-goods.reply: Then it has somewhere to be.
updrafts/workshop.bellows-exchange.offer: Your grips are coming unbound. Hold still, I’ll do both.
updrafts/workshop.bellows-exchange.knigh: Thank you. These have had a rough journey.
updrafts/workshop.bellows-exchange.reply: There. They’ll hold a few more falls.
keep/workshop.keepers-counter.offer: My old stamp still takes! Bring the blade over. Bow as well.
keep/workshop.keepers-counter.reply: Mind you don’t notch it on the first door.
court/workshop.white-exchange.offer: Found this under the stove. Kept dry all winter, somehow. Take it; I can’t sell it.
court/workshop.white-exchange.reply: Carefully’s the only way anything lasts up here.
court/workshop.sluice-counter.offer: A repair seal, dry beneath the drawer. A note reads: “Take what you can use.”
court/workshop.sluice-counter.reply: (The drawer slides shut on its own, as if it was waiting for that.)
inversion/workshop.last-inventory.offer: The damp missed this drawer. Take the fragment. One less thing to count, and I count all night.
inversion/workshop.last-inventory.knight: One less thing to carry. Thank you.
inversion/workshop.last-inventory.reply: Don’t get it wet. Off you go.
emberdeep/workshop.cinder-ledger.offer: Carried this through three collapsed tunnels, one of them on fire. Your turn.
emberdeep/workshop.cinder-ledger.reply: It’s been through enough. Don’t waste it.
outskirts/olan.reserve: Milekeeper left a reserve up above the first stretch of Hollow Mile. Let it go and the road bridges come down. There’s a seal in it, if you can reach it. I can’t, not with these knees.
woods/orra.moved: It moved. One minute since you left. Don’t say anything. It hasn’t done it twice yet.
updrafts/talla.first: Hold on. Talla. I mend the kites. The harness is tied off above the drafts, with the brake pin beside it. Take both.
updrafts/talla.revisit: Look at the stretch in that cloth. You’ve flown it hard. That’s what it’s for.
updrafts/edrin.first: Each gutter spills into the next, see? Where’d you climb up from? Nobody comes up the drafts. The cups tip when they’re full. Nobody’s touched them in years.
updrafts/edrin.revisit: Basin’s holding level. Everyone’s sharing it.
updrafts/oren.crown.ask: You. From the Causeway. The Crown runs on three machines. None’s turned since the wind changed. Get them going.
updrafts/oren.crown.thanks: All three turning. And it’s lowering something it was never built to carry.
updrafts/oren.crown.harness: I patched that harness. The wind found every loose stitch.
updrafts/oren.crown.flues: Warm air. The old flues are drawing again.
updrafts/oren.crown.rain: Rain’s running. All it wanted was an open gutter.
updrafts/oren.crown.sails: I’m stopping up here with the sails.
updrafts/oren.crown.dry: There. The Crown kept it dry all this while. It’s yours.
marksman/mara.first: That’s not right. You. From the camp road. You got through the Woods, then.
marksman/mara.revisit: The road east is on my chart. Nobody’s walked it since I measured it.
marksman/senn.first: Mm. You’ve got a portal on you? Blue’s yours. Put it wherever you want to start. Orange is nailed to the far scaffold.
marksman/senn.revisit: Blue moves, orange doesn’t. Orange belongs to the watch. Don’t ask me to unpick it.
keep/tovin.greet: Tovin, mason. These gates take two: one to hold, one to pass. I’ll stand on the plate. You go.
keep/oren.keep.first: Chains hold. Causeway, wasn’t it? The floor’s another story. Watch your feet.
keep/oren.keep.revisit: I know these links. Mended half of them myself, years back.
keep/veya.first: How’d you get in? The gate’s been shut a month. The west gate’s the only road out. East is more Keep, and it isn’t friendly.
keep/veya.revisit: If you bring anything down from the high archive, bring it west. Don’t leave it lying about.
keep/veya.road: That’s a road home, open. Worth more than a crown.
causeway/oren.reserve: There’s a spare seal up on the camp’s high bracket. Unwind the drum and the Chainwalk service span comes down.
gaol/vey.gaol.first: You. From the fire. They locked me in with his keys. Funny, if you think about it.
gaol/vey.gaol.revisit: These doors open from this side. Always did. Nobody tried.
gaol/vey.gaol.keys: Take them. I’ve set down heavier things than keys.
gaol/vey.gaol.reserve: They’ve unsealed the reserve above the east end of the court. Pull its chain and two maintenance bridges come down. There’s a dressing in it. Nobody in here’s going to use it.
frostfell/nim.greet: Shh, don’t breathe on it. You’re not from the streets. Stay near the flame. Some walls here aren’t real; it shows you which.
frostfell/nim.line1: You heard that too? It’s all right. The fire’s still ours.
frostfell/nim.line2: Your footprints stopped in the snow, then started again higher up. How?
frostfell/nim.line3: I’ll mind the fires now. Go on.
frostfell/nim.line4: I saved one flame. Just one. It’s enough if we’re careful.
court/vey.court1: No orders today. Sit a minute. Listen.
court/vey.court2: Hear it? I used to keep the road. Water’s easier; it goes where you send it.
court/vey.court3: You made it out of there too, then. Could you free the service wheel, back west? Nothing flows until it turns.
court/ada1: Molds are cooling. The court still orders cups, and nobody leaves with anything in them.
court/ada2: Dry molds crack. I’m idle till Vey’s wheel turns. You’re no petitioner. Past the refuge, their cold spells freeze a channel hard enough to stand on.
court/vey.court.keeper: I put the standard down for good. Water runs downhill and doesn’t argue.
emberdeep/oren.ember.greet: You again. I’m starting to think you’re following me. That seal throws back anything iron. It’s never once stopped me.
shores/oren.kneel.warn: Don’t. It goes to whoever touches it.
shores/oren.kneel.reply: You should be. I was, the first month. After that you’re too tired.
shores/oren.kneel.hand: …You’d do that? I’ve knelt on this shore since the leaves turned, and not one of them—
shores/oren.kneel.walk: If you’re going in there, aye. I can.
colony/sable.struck: I heard what happened at the gate. The King’s tap is on the conduit, over the well. Do what you came to do, and go.
colony/sable.pipe.helped: The King’s pipe took the spring. There’s a tap on the conduit, right over the well. I can’t climb to it, and they’d see me if I could. And you brought one in by the hand. Good. Get the water down and I’ll see to you both.
colony/sable.pipe.kneeling: The King’s pipe took the spring. There’s a tap on the conduit, right over the well. I can’t climb to it, and they’d see me if I could. There’s a man kneeling at the gate. Nobody’s taken his hand, and they won’t let me out to him.
colony/sable.rushing: Not by rushing. Mind the one who walks the conduit. He hears the alms-bell like any of them.
colony/sable.spoon: Slowly. One spoon at a time. It helps more than you think.
colony/oren.unwrap: …There. Know me now? Stay close in the yard. I can open those shackles. It’s what I do.
colony/sable.spring: There. The spring will find its way back up the pipe now, a little at a time.
colony/sable.spring.kneeling: There. The spring will find its way back up the pipe now, a little at a time. That man at the gate is still kneeling. You know where the gate is.
colony/sable.tap: The tap’s on the conduit, over the well. Mind the one who walks it.
colony/sable.onething: One thing at a time. Start there.
colony/woman.gate: The King came through in summer. On foot, if you’ll believe it, with one hand in a glove. Had the pipe built before the leaves turned. Never once took that glove off.
path/oren.inside: He always did build things to be opened from the inside.
palace/king.dial: Every dial in this house says a quarter to four, I had them cut that way. I wanted it to be morning a little longer.
palace/oren.sun: Leave him the sun. It’s all he has left.
palace/oren.higher: He’ll not run this time. There’s nowhere higher to run.
palace/hydra.tide: You broke our chains, little knight. We don’t forget a thing like that. So we came to tell you.
palace/hydra.storm: The one you left on the beach did not stay on the beach. It’s walking back along every road you took, and it hasn’t stopped once.
palace/hydra.bite: Everywhere it goes, the fights you won start again. What you beat gets back up. Enough talk. Climb on. We’ll carry you back to the island.
palace/servant.green: The gardens must be green by first light, sir. The King says it’s always first light.
palace/servant.water: The King’s, sir. It came up the pipe from the tents. You can taste the tents in it.
gates/olan.1: Every time I come to it, it drops like that. Like it heard me coming.
gates/olan.2: It isn’t locked. It’s asking. There are things it wants done — climbs, crossings — and I can’t do them on my own. I’ve tried.
gates/olan.4: Then come — stay close. It opens from inside, if you’re quick enough.
gates/olan.6: You did it. I’ve stood at that wall half my life and never once seen what’s past it. Mind if I walk with you? I’d like to see where the road goes.
gates/olan.7: Still there? It’ll wait. So will I.
gates/olan.8: I keep thinking it’ll come down again behind us.
gates/olan.9: Mara said the road bends north after the Muster. I’ve never seen it bend.
gates/olan.10: Lead on. I’m right behind you.
gates/mara.1: You two as well? It came down in front of me an hour ago. I’ve been measuring it since. It doesn’t measure.
gates/mara.2: Olan. You got through yours? …Then help me with mine. Black Woods is on the other side, and I mean to chart it.
gates/mara.3: Well. That’s the strangest survey I’ll ever file. Come on, both of you — the Woods won’t map themselves.
gates/mara.4: Stay on the path. The Woods move the path when you’re not looking.
gates/mara.5: I’m writing all this down. Nobody will believe any of it.
gates/mara.6: I’ll run ahead and see what the roots are hiding. Don’t dawdle — I won’t wait forever.
gates/hale.1: Visitors. Figured as much — nobody comes this deep for the trees.
gates/hale.2: You’ll want to see the gate. Everyone does. Go on, then; show them how it’s done.
gates/hale.3: Huh. Faster than the last lot. The Woods are yours, for what they’re worth.
gates/bram.1: No. Not through that. I’ve watched it swallow people whole and spit them out on the far side, shaking.
gates/bram.2: You go. I’ll… I’ll hold the lamp here. For when you come back.
gates/bram.3: You came out. You actually came out. I can’t go past it. You carry it — you’re braver than me. It shows what’s real in the Thicket. Keep it lit.
gates/bram.4: Go on. The lamp’s better with you than with me.
gates/marksman-mara.1: There you are. This one’s a beauty — the best of them yet. Ten turns of it, and not one of them kind.
gates/keep-sweeper.1: Nothing behind that wall worth finding, friend. Just the stair and the damp.
gates/keep-sweeper.2: You’ve already got the grip. Whatever’s down there, you’ll come up the other side of it soon enough — then maybe you’ll want it open.
gates/keep-sweeper.3: Still. It’ll let you try now, if you’re stubborn.
gates/wall: The wall is black the way deep water is black. Something in it is listening.
ending/wake-delirious: Canvas. Cold earth. His own breath scraping back into his lungs.
ending/enemy-soldiers-enter: Boots stopped outside. The tent ties parted beneath a soldier’s knife.
ending/halfway-defense: He found his feet. One intruder fell. A second recoiled. For one impossible moment, training was enough.
ending/overwhelmed: Then the room doubled. His sword passed through a shadow. Three real blades did not.
ending/knight-killed: The Warden fell before the hallucination released him.
ending/flameblade-focus: At the killing stroke, fire gathered around the shape of a blade beside him.
ending/dream-images-return: Blue and orange mouths. A banked flame. A line beneath the world. The impossible returned all at once.
ending/rusty-axe-defense: He seized the burning weapon and drove the intruders from the tent, one by one.
ending/knight-collapses: When the last soldier fell, so did he.
ending/ordinary-axe-reveal: The fire went out. In his hand lay an ordinary, rusted axe.
ending/comrade-voice: He who saved us has awoken.
updrafts/cartographer.waiting: I need the wind moved, and a sword can’t do that. There’s a portal gun up at the Crown—if you find it, come back. Please.
colony/sable.fountains: For his fountains. He says the sun is coming up, and he wants to be clean for it.
colony/sable.dew: Not since the leaves turned. We give them the dew. A spoon at a time.
colony/oren.sea: As far as the sea would let me. Then it handed me to his men.
colony/oren.locks: Since the leaves turned. Long enough to learn every lock in that yard, and hate each one.
colony/oren.cup: Aye, and you look like a man who drank from the same cup.
shores/oren.kneel.what: Nobody here calls it anything. Flowers come up through the wrappings. After a while the bell’s all you hear.
shores/oren.kneel.down: Aye. Haven’t done anything else since the leaves turned.
shores/oren.kneel.who: Nobody the King remembers. Ask me again when there’s water.
shores/oren.kneel.keepup: I’ll keep up. I’ve been following people a long while.
palace/servant.mask: So he doesn’t have to see our faces, sir. The gold’s for him. Not for us.
palace/servant.where: On the Throne of Noon, sir, past the Crown. The doors only open for the sun.
gates/mara.again: Ready? The Woods aren’t getting any closer.
gates/hale.again: Still here? Go on. They’re watching.
gates/bram.again: I’ll hold the lamp. You go.
gates/marksman-mara.again: Ten turns. I’ll wait at the top.
colony/knight.why: Why does the King want it?
colony/knight.nothing: Is there nothing to drink here?
ascend/w1-o1-road.vey: Fire’s for anyone. Just don’t touch the white flowers.
ascend/w1-o1-verge.mara: Oh! Hello. Mara, surveyor. Three posts off this road: Ash, Glass, Iron. Touch them for me?
ascend/w1-o1-camp.sentinel: Came up the west road? Huh. Touch the stake on the perch.
ascend/w1-o1-camp.rowan: Gate’s shut. You got through anyway. Bell’s up the east tower.
ascend/w1-o1-camp.rowan.done: There. Now we’ll hear them coming.
ascend/w1-o1-cut.olan: Clock’s stopped. The cut’s worse. Only the glass in the air holds.
ascend/w1-o1-muster.mara: Made it. Any bearings for me?
ascend/w1-o1-muster.mara.done: Ash, Glass, Iron. They agree. The road goes through.
ascend/w2-w2-refuge.orra: Stopped again. Don’t ask me the time.
ascend/w2-w2-refuge.pell: Not resin crew, are you? A cut pod kicks. Get a blade.
ascend/w2-w2-refuge.mara: You again. The tunnel comes up right here. Refuge is ahead.
ascend/w2-w2-clearing.hale: Sword was in those roots. Cost me a shoulder. Take it.
ascend/w2-w2-kitchen.elsie: Mind the step. Elsie. My lantern’s stuck up in the branches. Fetch it?
ascend/w2-w2-edge.bram: Easy, easy… Bram. Light goes through a branch? It isn’t there.
ascend/w3-c3-camp.sable: Not one of the yard’s, are you? Nothing up there’s moved in a month.
ascend/w3-c3-camp.oren: Hear that? Nothing. The Drop Yard lift is free. Stand on it.
ascend/w3-c3-hoist.oren: She comes back down on her own. Ride her up.
ascend/w3-c3-patrol.silas: …thirty-nine, forty. Can’t stop. Break the gear up the ladder?
ascend/w3-c3-patrol.silas.done: Forty-one. Then I sat. My choice.
ascend/w4-u4-bellows.talla: Mind the pad. It throws harder than it looks.
ascend/w4-u4-choir.cartographer: Footsteps? Good. I need one reading from the upper funnel. Over the tall pipe.
ascend/w4-u4-choir.cartographer.done: That interval shouldn’t exist. Help me move the desk outside?
ascend/w4-u4-catcher.edrin: Each gutter spills to the next. Don’t stand about. The cups crack.
ascend/w4-u4-span.ilyra: You came across on the drafts? Then the flues are drawing again.
ascend/w5-m5-camp.mara: You again. The watch has shot at me all morning. Meet the bolt. Don’t duck it.
ascend/w5-m5-release.recruit: I can make the crossing. I can. My helmet’s up the tower, that’s all.
ascend/w5-m5-release.recruit.done: That’s my uncle’s. Right. The bridge.
ascend/w6-k6-refectory.veya: Sit, if you’re cold. The clock says three forty-one. It always has.
ascend/w6-k6-refectory.tovin: See the stone in the arch? Its weight holds the gate.
ascend/w6-k6-quarter.tovin: Take the key. Point it at pale stone. The stone remembers it was a door.
ascend/w6-k6-belfry.idris: Mind the boards. I’ve only just swept them.
ascend/w6-k6-loft.idris: The bell stopped when its weight went. I sweep under it anyway.
ascend/w6-k6-archive.archivist: Three volumes fell with the upper gallery. Bring them down? Mind the bindings.
ascend/w6-k6-archive.archivist.done: All three disagree about the gate. I’ll sit with them a while.
ascend/w7-g7-cells.keeper: Service door. No work order. And someone’s moved my lunch up the catwalk.
ascend/w7-g7-cells.keeper.done: Nobody said which side of the door I eat on. Leave it on the latch.
ascend/w7-g7-vigil.vey: You. I carried a standard once. Now I carry his keys.
ascend/w7-g7-vigil.enna: Don’t look down the well. He never looks at us.
ascend/w8-f8-refuge.nim: Up through the mine? Warm your hands. I’ve braziers to light.
ascend/w8-f8-streets.nim: One lit. Fire takes the slip out of the stone. Only near it, mind.
ascend/w8-f8-hearth.nim: This one’s mine. The works are past the floes.
ascend/w8-f8-hearth.neighbour: Coal’s in the upper shelter, up the chimney. I can’t manage the steps.
ascend/w8-f8-hearth.neighbour.done: Room’s warmer. Sit. You’ve been on your feet all day.
ascend/w8-f8-works.ilyra: Nim’s fire in the draft. That’s what the Choir was missing.
ascend/w8-f8-engine.sentinel: Engine’s frozen. Ring the bell at the crown and every post will hear.
ascend/w9-s9-wheel.vey: Water I understand. It goes downhill. The wheel’s catch is past the far side.
ascend/w9-s9-refuge.ada: Hit the overflow hard enough and it stands up like glass.
ascend/w9-s9-glass.handler: Don’t touch his back. He’s too hot to sleep. The cold intake’s up through the roof.
ascend/w9-s9-glass.handler.done: Look at his feet. He only does that asleep.
ascend/w10-e10-door.oren: Court’s cold still on you? Enjoy it. Nothing down here’s done cooling.
ascend/w10-e10-draw.oren: The seal turns iron back. Lets me through. Don’t ask.
ascend/w10-e10-bridge.oren: I used to be the weight that held this. Now it holds itself.
ascend/w10-e10-line.maker: I finish one, he smashes it. Every time. The counters are up the chute.
ascend/w10-e10-line.maker.done: Mine’s green. His is green. Break time.
ascend/w10-e10-line.breaker: It comes down, I scrap it. Nobody’s been in that office for months.
ascend/w10-e10-line.breaker.done: Same piece, counted twice. Sit. She brought lunch for two.
ascend/w10-e10-stair.oren: Foundry’s through there. Still pouring. Nobody to pour for.
ascend/w11-f11-stair.oren: Every mould in Emberdeep came from down here. Keep your distance.
ascend/w11-f11-crane.automaton: Please hold the left panel. I am building a birdhouse. My hands are too large.
ascend/w11-f11-crane.automaton.done: It is holding. A bird is inspecting it. Do not move.
ascend/w11-f11-look.oren: Machines don’t keep standing orders. Whatever it pours, don’t be under it.
ascend/w12-i12-fall.oren: Down here, even the floor disagrees with you.
ascend/w12-i12-court.neighbour: I invited her for tea. She says my floor is wrong. The service is up the chimney.
ascend/w12-i12-court.neighbour.done: One sugar. Six years, and I still put in two.
ascend/w12-i12-court.neighbour2: On my table, please. His down is not my down.
ascend/w13-v13-mouth.oren: The books hold you once. Nobody’s returned them.
ascend/w13-v13-vigil.figure: I was waving. The release is up the chimney. I can’t see past the lights.
ascend/w13-v13-vigil.figure.done: The glass was colder on the other side. I’ll stay by the lights.
ascend/w14-k14-stair.oren: Two marks, one visitor. There’s always a catch.
ascend/w14-k14-alcove.oren: Something stayed behind when you moved. Try the key again.
ascend/w14-k14-bellkeeper.bellkeeper: Three short, two long. Break a bell and the backup starts. The tower’s up the chimney.
ascend/w14-k14-bellkeeper.bellkeeper.don: Quiet at last. They’re leaving their posts.
ascend/w14-k14-rail.oren: Tracks. Someone built a way out. I’m taking it.
ascend/w15-d15-siding.miner: Someone there? Take the siding! The cage is stuck.
ascend/w15-d15-siding.miner.done: My name’s back where it belongs. Give my legs a moment.
ascend/w16-t16-sailors.sailor: Lost half a brass charm up the rigging. If you go aloft, look.
ascend/w16-t16-sailors.sailor.done: He has his half. I have mine. Neither of us lets go.
ascend/w16-t16-sailors.apprentice: He says the charm holds the ship together. I say it’s the rope.
ascend/w16-t16-sailors.apprentice.done: Still the rope. I’m keeping the charm, though.
ascend/w17-s17-porch.organizer: Candles! The tin’s in the upper wreck cabin. Keep it dry!
ascend/w17-s17-porch.organizer.done: Candles lit! Bring the cake out here.
ascend/w17-s17-porch.soldier: A birthday? Fine. Don’t make an announcement.
ascend/w18-c18-family.mother: My sealed cup is in the old shelter. Bring that one. I want to know where it’s been.
ascend/w18-c18-family.mother.done: Sable answered my questions. Mine first. A little, to start.
ascend/w18-c18-family.sable: The spring runs clean. I’ll explain what changed, when she’s ready.
ascend/w18-c18-family.sable.done: The cup’s beside the bed. We spoke quietly, once the little one slept.
ascend/w19-p19-pilgrim.pilgrim: Travelling lighter. Send my sack up the sling? Don’t open it.
ascend/w19-p19-pilgrim.pilgrim.done: Medals, mostly. That one steadies the pot. Sit. I’ll make lunch.
ascend/w19-p19-q-bench.pilgrim: I’ll carry it from here. Least I can do is lunch.
ascend/w20-s20-garden.gardener: His Majesty wants the three shutters open. The flowers need the dark. The handles are through the gallery.
ascend/w20-s20-garden.gardener.done: By the bench. That one hasn’t opened in years. She liked it in the evenings.
ascend/w20-s20-sea.hydra: You broke our chains. Your Echo walks your roads backwards. Climb on.
ascend/w21-fo21-map.mara: Your chart still has a road here. Mine stopped.
ascend/w21-fo21-map.mara.done: There it is. A way through the blank.
ascend/w21-fo21-camp.rowan: The bell is behind you. It always was.
ascend/w21-fo21-camp.rowan.done: Someone answered. I can leave it ringing.
ascend/w21-fo21-q-chart.mara: I drew the way out. Keep the part that still leads somewhere.
ascend/w21-fo21-q-chart.mara.done: The blank has an edge now.
ascend/w21-fo21-q-bell.rowan: I heard it. That was enough.
ascend/w22-fw22-kitchen.elsie: I left a bowl out. Habit, I suppose.
ascend/w22-fw22-kitchen.elsie.done: Still warm. Don’t ask me how.
ascend/w22-fw22-q-lantern.elsie: I knew you’d find the table.
ascend/w22-fw22-q-lantern.elsie.done: You never did like eating alone.
ascend/w23-fc23-silas.silas: Forty paces. I remember the forty-first better.
ascend/w23-fc23-silas.silas.done: I chose that step. That part still belongs to me.
ascend/w23-fc23-q-governor.silas: There was a bench beyond the turning point. I never knew.
ascend/w23-fc23-q-governor.silas.done: I sat there because I wanted to.
ascend/w24-fu24-choir.cartographer: The same interval. I hear it even when the air goes quiet.
ascend/w24-fu24-choir.cartographer.done: There. Above the pipes. That was the part I missed.
ascend/w24-fu24-q-funnel.cartographer: It was never silence. I had stopped listening.
ascend/w25-fm25-release.recruit: I made the crossing. I keep making it, to be sure I did.
ascend/w25-fm25-release.recruit.done: You came up behind me. I didn’t duck.
ascend/w25-fm25-q-top.recruit: The helmet was never what held me up.
ascend/w25-fm25-q-top.recruit.done: I can put it down now. The bridge will still be there.
ascend/w26-fk26-archive.archivist: There was a fourth volume. It agreed with all three, so I left it.
ascend/w26-fk26-archive.archivist.done: You found it. Read me the last line.
ascend/w26-fk26-q-rain.archivist: It says the gate was only ever a door.
ascend/w26-fk26-q-rain.archivist.done: I will sit with that one for a while.
ascend/w27-fg27-cells.keeper: I still hold the door. Habit. Nobody comes through.
ascend/w27-fg27-cells.keeper.done: You came through. That’s a first.
ascend/w27-fg27-q-catwalk.keeper: Brown paper. Same lunch. Different side of the door.
ascend/w27-fg27-q-catwalk.keeper.done: Leave it open behind you. I’ll eat outside.
ascend/w28-ff28-hearth.neighbour: The stove went cold the day after. I kept the cup on the sill anyway.
ascend/w28-ff28-hearth.neighbour.done: You climbed it. The last step too.
ascend/w28-ff28-q-shelter.neighbour: That’s the warmth I remember. Not the coal.
ascend/w28-ff28-q-shelter.neighbour.done: Sit a minute. Then go on.
ascend/w29-fs29-glass.handler: He never settled again without the cold. I kept the glove.
ascend/w29-fs29-glass.handler.done: Gently. He knows the glove, not you.
ascend/w29-fs29-q-pen.handler: Look at his feet. Properly asleep.
ascend/w29-fs29-q-pen.handler.done: That’s all I wanted. One more time.
ascend/w30-fe30-line.maker: Same piece, round and round. We never stopped it.
ascend/w30-fe30-line.maker.done: You can stop it. Up there, with the counters.
ascend/w30-fe30-q-loft.maker: Both green. Nobody counted after that.
ascend/w30-fe30-q-loft.maker.done: Lunch for two, on the bench, for good.
ascend/w31-ff31-crane.automaton: I made a sixth birdhouse. My hands are still too large for the roof.
ascend/w31-ff31-crane.automaton.done: Please hold the panel. Gently. A bird is near.
ascend/w31-ff31-q-shelf.automaton: It is holding. The bird is inside.
ascend/w31-ff31-q-shelf.automaton.done: We should stop moving. It is sleeping.
ascend/w32-fi32-court.neighbour: We never agreed which way was down. We had tea anyway.
ascend/w32-fi32-court.neighbour.done: Bring the second cup. Either table.
ascend/w32-fi32-q-service.neighbour.done: Her down, my down. The tea stays in the cup.
ascend/w33-fv33-vigil.figure: I went toward the lights. I wanted to see what was behind them.
ascend/w33-fv33-vigil.figure.done: Come and look. It’s not what I feared.
ascend/w33-fv33-q-light.figure: Only more windows. More people waving.
ascend/w34-fk34-bellkeeper.bellkeeper: The bell rang one last time after you left. I still count it.
ascend/w34-fk34-bellkeeper.bellkeeper.do: Three short, two long. Then nothing.
ascend/w34-fk34-q-signal.bellkeeper.done: They all went home. I can too.
ascend/w35-fd35-siding.miner: My name is in the ledger. I keep reading it, to be sure.
ascend/w35-fd35-siding.miner.done: Down the siding. You know the way now.
ascend/w35-fd35-q-ledger.miner.done: I’ll walk out on the main line this time.
ascend/w36-ft36-sailors.sailor: We each kept a half. We never once let go.
ascend/w36-ft36-sailors.sailor.done: The rigging again. Keep an eye out.
ascend/w36-ft36-q-charm.sailor: Still the rope. It was always the rope.
ascend/w37-fs37-porch.organizer: They lit every candle. Nobody made an announcement.
ascend/w37-fs37-porch.organizer.done: Up in the wreck. Keep it dry.
ascend/w37-fs37-q-cabin.organizer.done: It is quiet out here. I like it quiet.
ascend/w38-fc38-family.mother: The cup is still beside the bed. I asked my questions first.
ascend/w38-fc38-family.mother.done: The old shelter. You know where it’s been.
ascend/w38-fc38-q-cup.mother: Only a little, to start. Then more.
ascend/w38-fc38-q-cup.mother.done: She is asleep. We spoke quietly.
ascend/w39-fp39-pilgrim.pilgrim: I left the medals somewhere. Not all of them.
ascend/w39-fp39-pilgrim.pilgrim.done: Send the sack up. Don’t open it. Fine, open it.
ascend/w39-fp39-q-bench.pilgrim: One medal. It holds the pot steady.
ascend/w39-fp39-q-bench.pilgrim.done: That is the right weight to carry.
ascend/w40-fs40-garden.gardener: The shutters stay closed now. The garden decided.
ascend/w40-fs40-garden.gardener.done: Through the gallery. Mind the light.
ascend/w40-fs40-sea.hydra: You broke our chains twice now. Climb on. We will shade you as long as we can.
ascend/w40-fs40-q-upper.gardener: Look, by the bench. Every evening, now.
ascend/w40-fs40-q-upper.gardener.done: She liked it in the evenings. So do I.
palace/rift.servant.line: You were here already, sir. Last night, in the Hall of Hours. You stood in front of the big dial and it went backwards.
palace/rift.servant.leave: This, sir. On the floor under the dial. I’ve tried polishing it. It won’t take a shine.
palace/rift.servant.backwards: A quarter to four, then half past three, then three. Then it was gone.
palace/rift.servant.scrub: Yes, sir. The gold’s for him.
colony/rift.woman.line: Before the King, another one came through that gate. Looked like you. Didn’t stop—went straight through the tents like we weren’t there, and a bell rang for it that nobody pulled.
colony/rift.woman.leave: A bit of itself. Glass. Fell out of the air right by my cup.
colony/rift.woman.hurt: Didn’t so much as look at anyone. That was worse, somehow.
colony/rift.woman.fever: We all are. Doesn’t mean I didn’t see it.
palace/rift.knight.leave: That wasn’t me. What did it leave?
barks/hale: Easy, shoulder. One more and I’m done.
barks/elsie: Bit more salt. Bit less burning.
barks/cartographer: Ridge here. Cold air there. Good.
barks/recruit: Feet apart. Swing. Don’t drop it. Don’t drop it.
barks/servicekeeper: No order, no entry. No order, no entry.
barks/nim: Stay lit, little one. Stay lit.
barks/frostwoman: Bit of coal, bit of warm. That’ll do.
barks/foundry: Chalk the line, then cut. Never the other way.
barks/upstairs: Not one drop over his side. Not one.
barks/miner: Sound rock. Sound rock. Hollow. Hm.
barks/sailor: Coil it sunwise. Sunwise, I said.
barks/organizer: Candles, cake, him. Two out of three.
barks/soldier: Strap’s slipping again. Course it is.
barks/mother: My cup. My own cup. Is that so much?
barks/pilgrim: Nearly up. Nearly is a lovely word.
barks/gardener: Not too much. They like it dark and thirsty.
barks/edrin: One cup full, the next one waits.
barks/veya: Keep the fire low. Low and long.
barks/sickwoman: Just a moment’s rest. Just a moment.
woods/refuge.task.moths: They’ll rest a moment, then go on as you come close. East, through the trees. They tire eventually.
woods/refuge.task.log: That step wants a board. Hale cuts wood down the path; he’ll spare one if you help him split that log of his.
ascend/errands.refuge.0: The moths took my lantern, off into the trees past the kitchen. They never go far at a time. Could you follow them?
ascend/errands.refuge.1: Bring her home steady. If you fall, the moths will have her back.
causeway/defector.task.lead: I can’t start on my own. If you walk, I’ll walk. If you stop, I’ll stop. Mind the old patrol arms on the road west; they still come down.
causeway/defector.task.key: Take the key out of my back, would you? Hang it on the hook at the top of the toll tower. Where I can see it, and nobody can wind me.
ascend/errands.defector.0: Thirty-nine, forty. The governor at the top of the ladder turns me. Strike its bright tooth; anything else and you only bruise your arm.
ascend/errands.defector.1: Take the key from my back, would you? Hang it on the toll hook, at the top of the next climb. Where nobody can wind me.
keep/archivist.thanks: I’ll carry the third account. It’s the heaviest argument.
keep/archivist.task.reading: The reading room is west, high up past the first stair. The masonry is cracked. Break through.
keep/archivist.task.wall: The steward wrote on the outer wall, beyond the belfry. You’ll need to climb it.
keep/archivist.task.pages: The bell-ringer’s pages are on the belfry ledges. Once you lift one, the wind takes the rest. Be quick.
ascend/errands.archivist.0: Three accounts of the night the gate fell: one bricked up in the stacks, one at the top of the gallery, and the bell-ringer’s pages, out in the rain. Bring them?
ascend/errands.archivist.1: The bell-ringer saw the counterweight. Bring them here.
